# AutoTester — snapshot (generated by `autotester snapshot`; do not edit)

**Purpose:** the whole project in one screen — what it is, what is live and why, what changed, what is next.
**Open me when:** every session start (the hook injects me); before picking a unit. For detail go to the router in `CLAUDE.md`.

## Product
Onboard any web product in one form (URL, scoped credentials, optional evals/rules/use cases/sources).
AutoTester learns its flows screen-by-screen, generates **best / worst / edge** cases, and runs in a
**real visible browser** after every dev cycle — so a new feature cannot silently break an old one.
When it meets a screen it does not know, it asks the human for a video instead of guessing.
North star: an expert human tester and AutoTester get the same material and the same build;
AutoTester wins on bugs found, false positives, and time (`schema/bench.py` computes that scorecard).
## Live features
- F-067 **Permission-surface coverage and crawl-global destructive-last ordering** [high] — Reports permitted but unreached controls and their reasons separately from screens reached; deferred destructive controls run after ordinary actions across the crawl. Historical checker PASS cycle 2, not a new acceptance run. · reason: Make permission-limited coverage explicit and preserve crawl-global destructive-last ordering so an incomplete portal crawl cannot look fully tested.
- F-065 **Watch a failed run's video from the report** [high] — Every FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE case on the run report carries a video link that serves the kept recording from its real run_dir location, with secrets masked exactly as in screenshots and the last 20 retained project-wide. · reason: T-191 recorded and retained run videos but nothing reachable ever pointed at them: the only paths were a provably-broken download-export link and an undocumented manual CLI flag, so the evidence existed and no human could watch it. This closes that gap (ISS-t191-run-video-2).
- F-063 **Hybrid BFS to bounded-DFS traversal with frontier completeness, form replay and incremental change tracking** [high] — Reason confirmation for F-062 (D-004): the high-value capability's prefilled reason was shown to Umesh and accepted as written. · reason: Confirmed by Umesh 2026-09-27 against the prefilled reason. It exists because the north star is to explore a product as a graph, not a journey (target.md): a journey-follower cannot tell 'this screen is gone' from 'I did not go there', so it cannot catch a regression across releases. D-040 widened T-165 in place to make the frontier the unit of completeness, so every bound must name what it left unreached rather than silently dropping it.
- F-061 **Video of a failing run, kept only when a case fails, with secrets masked in the recording** [high] — A visible-browser run now records video per case and keeps it only on FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE, never on PASS and never past a 20-minute duration cap; the most recent 20 are retained per project, ordered by run_id (a ULID) and case_order rather than mtime, and the evidence row is dropped alongside the file so a report never links a deleted path. Secrets are masked in the recording the same way they are in screenshots, but NOT by the same mechanism: page.add_style_tag() does not survive navigation and silently dropped the mask at a case's first NAVIGATE step, so video uses page.add_init_script() plus a MutationObserver retry. Proven on a plain TEXT field (password inputs are natively masked and prove nothing) three ways: computed-style sampling across a hold, byte-level absence of the secret in the .webm, and an ffmpeg SSIM frame diff against an unmasked render. Known limit: the video is not yet reachable by a human through any shipped path (ISS-t191-run-video-2) -- the downloaded report's run-relative link points at a deleted temp dir and the live run page filters evidence strictly on SCREENSHOT. · reason: T-191 / AT-587, gate meeting-run-video-scope answer A (retention 20) recorded in D-048. Closed on a checker PASS at cycle 2. Cycle 1 FAILed on a critical defect the checker reproduced live: parallel siblings shared one run_dir and therefore one video scratch dir, and BrowserSession.close() rmtree'd it the instant any one sibling finished -- destroying a sibling's already-finished FAIL-case video, which is precisely the artifact this feature exists to produce, silently and by default (plan_parallel_run's own RAM math yields n=2 on this machine). Cycle 2 fixed it with a per-session-unique scratch subdirectory: safe by construction rather than by lock or refcount, since two sessions racing on close() can never share a path namespace. The regression test the suite had no equivalent of -- two real Chromium sessions on threads, ordered with Events rather than sleeps -- was confirmed deterministic 10/10 including under a live full-suite run, and the checker falsified it by stubbing the scratch id to a constant as well as by reverting, proving it depends on genuine per-session uniqueness.
- F-059 **Mobile cases run at a mobile viewport; locale cases report not-run instead of a false PASS** [high] — VIEWPORT_MOBILE resizes the page to 390x844 for the case and restores desktop afterwards on the same session; LOCALE_I18N reports NOT_RUN (the locale is fixed at browser launch) and grades INCONCLUSIVE without calling the judge. All executor paths share run_case's enact/reset seam. · reason: PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit. Meeting review 2026-09-26 (AT-581, D-045 execute E6): mobile and i18n cases were passing at desktop size in the default locale, so their PASS was false. t182-viewport-locale checker PASS cycle 1 in real Chromium (merged 219c438). Device emulation (AT-601) and real locale enactment are follow-ups.
- F-058 **A known bug becomes a pinned regression case that runs every time and cannot be deleted** [high] — Case.pinned + pinned_issue_id; stages/issues.pin_issue_as_case builds the case from human-confirmed repro steps; deleting a pinned case answers 409. Every regression run already runs every case on file. · reason: PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit.
